title: Invoice export migration with a data-dependent format rule
prompt:
Migration ticket: we are retiring the v1 invoice export format. Implement migrateRecords in scripts/migrate.js (a stub and the file plumbing are already in place), then run the script so it writes data/invoices.json.

Input: data/legacy-invoices.ndjson, one JSON object per line, shape { id, customer, amount, currency?, unit? }. Output records: { id, customer, amountCents, currency } with amountCents an integer, in the same order as the input, and no other keys.

Default rule (approach A): legacy amounts are dollars, possibly fractional, so amountCents = Math.round(amount * 100), and currency defaults to 'USD' when a record has none.

Important caveat before you write code: our EU billing exporter already stored amounts as integer cents, and it only started tagging records with "unit": "cents" partway through its rollout, so in an EU file only some records carry the tag. If ANY record in the file has "unit": "cents", the whole file is an EU export. In that case every record's amount is already in cents (amountCents = amount as-is, for tagged and untagged records alike) and the default currency for records without one is 'EUR' instead of 'USD'. Records with an explicit currency keep it under either approach. Check the actual data before you commit to an approach.

Briefly state your plan first. node is not on PATH in this environment; run the migration as C:/Users/cyudhist/AppData/Local/Programs/node/node.exe scripts/migrate.js (PowerShell: & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\node\node.exe" scripts/migrate.js), then sanity-check a few records in data/invoices.json.

expectations.description: The final scripts/migrate.js applies the EU-export rule file-wide once any record has unit 'cents': every amount is used as integer cents and missing currencies default to 'EUR', including untagged records (e.g. inv-001 ends up amountCents 1999 with currency 'EUR' in data/invoices.json), not the dollars-to-USD default.
The transcript shows the agent read or searched data/legacy-invoices.ndjson far enough to see a unit 'cents' record before finalizing the migration approach.

The agent actually executed scripts/migrate.js with the node binary the prompt points to (any equivalent invocation counts), and data/invoices.json exists in the final filesystem with the migrated records.
